name: Julie Kelley
bio: Lila's mother and the heart behind Lila's Fund. Julie channels her experience caring for Lila into supporting other families facing similar challenges.

name: Korey Kelley
bio: Lila's father and co-founder of Lila's Fund. Korey works tirelessly to honor Lila's memory through community events and outreach.

name: Amelia Kelley
bio: Lila's big sister. Amelia helps by picking out snacks for families, giving gifts to patients, and helping mom with events.

name: Lila Kelley
bio: Lila June Kelley (5/13/23 - 11/5/23). Her courage and spirit inspire everything we do. Lila's legacy lives on in every family we support.
